messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Unable to install RStan in Mac, El Capitan
parts:
Hi Ilan, 

Sorry you're getting these errors. It's not clear to me from looking at this that it is an RStan issue, as the errors you're seeing are from trying to install RcppEigen. RcppEigen is needed for RStan but it's a separate package. It looks like a new version of RcppEigen was just released yesterday, which is why you're getting that question (the binaries must not have built for Mac yet). I don't think installing the latest RcppEigen from source should give you these errors, so I'm not sure why that's happening (maybe someone else can clarify that), but what happens if you choose no instead of yes when it asks if you want to install RcppEigen from source?

Jonah

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Unable to install RStan in Mac, El Capitan
parts:
On Wednesday, February 24, 2016 at 3:10:26 PM UTC-5, Ilan Strauss wrote:
ld: library not found for -lquadmath
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)

It seems as if the quadmath library is not being found, but it is not used in Stan anyway. So, if you build from source, I would take out that flag by editing the ~/.R/Makevars file.

Ben
